items.source: When using the JMS 1.0.2 API, this ConnectionFactory will switch into queue/topic mode according to the JMS API methods used at runtime: createQueueConnection and createTopicConnection will lead to queue/topic mode, respectively; generic createConnection calls will lead to a JMS 1.1 connection which is able to serve both modes.
items.translation: 在使用 JMS 1.0.2 API 时，此 ConnectionFactory 将根据运行时使用的 JMS API 方法切换到队列/主题模式：`createQueueConnection` 和 `createTopicConnection` 将分别导致进入队列/主题模式；通用的 `createConnection` 调用将导致生成一个能够同时支持两种模式的 JMS 1.1 连接。

items.source: By default, only one single Session will be cached, with further requested Sessions being created and disposed on demand. Consider raising the "sessionCacheSize" value in case of a high-concurrency environment.
items.translation: 默认情况下，仅缓存一个 Session，后续请求的 Session 将根据需要创建和销毁。在高并发环境中，请考虑提高"sessionCacheSize" 值。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 5, this class supports JMS 2.0 JMSContext calls and therefore requires the JMS 2.0 API to be present at runtime. It may nevertheless run against a JMS 1.1 driver (bound to the JMS 2.0 API) as long as no actual JMS 2.0 calls are triggered by the application's setup.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 5 起，该类支持 JMS 2.0 `JMSContext` 调用，因此需要在运行时提供 JMS 2.0 API。尽管如此，只要应用程序的配置不会触发实际的 JMS 2.0 调用，它仍可与绑定到 JMS 2.0 API 的 JMS 1.1 驱动程序一起运行。

items.source: NOTE: This ConnectionFactory requires explicit closing of all Sessions obtained from its shared Connection. This is the usual recommendation for native JMS access code anyway. However, with this ConnectionFactory, its use is mandatory in order to actually allow for Session reuse.
items.translation: 注意：此 ConnectionFactory 需要显式关闭从其共享连接获取的所有 Sessions。 这本来就是原生 JMS 访问代码的通常建议。然而，使用此 ConnectionFactory 是强制性的，以便实际允许 Session 重用。

items.source: Note also that MessageConsumers obtained from a cached Session won't get closed until the Session will eventually be removed from the pool. This may lead to semantic side effects in some cases. For a durable subscriber, the logical Session.close() call will also close the subscription. Re-registering a durable consumer for the same subscription on the same Session handle is not supported; close and reobtain a cached Session first.
items.translation: 同样请注意，从缓存的 `Session` 获取的 `MessageConsumers` 将在 `Session` 最终从池中移除之前不会被关闭。在某些情况下，这可能会导致语义副作用。对于持久化订阅者，逻辑上的 `Session.close()` 调用也会关闭该订阅。不支持在同一 `Session` 句柄上为同一订阅重新注册持久化消费者；请首先关闭并重新获取缓存的 `Session`。

items.source:
Last but not least, MessageProducers and MessageConsumers for temporary
queues and topics (TemporaryQueue/TemporaryTopic) will never be cached.
Unfortunately, WebLogic JMS happens to implement the temporary queue/topic
interfaces on its regular destination implementation, mis-indicating that
none of its destinations can be cached. Please use a different connection
pool/cache on WebLogic, or customize this class for WebLogic purposes.
items.translation: 最后但同样重要的是，临时队列和主题（TemporaryQueue/TemporaryTopic）的 MessageProducers 和 MessageConsumers 永远不会被缓存。不幸的是，WebLogic JMS 恰好在其常规目标实现上实现了临时队列/主题接口，错误地表明其所有目标都无法被缓存。请在 WebLogic 上使用不同的连接池/缓存，或为此类目的自定义此类。

items.source:
This cache size is the maximum limit for the number of cached Sessions
per session acknowledgement type (auto, client, dups_ok, transacted).
As a consequence, the actual number of cached Sessions may be up to
four times as high as the specified value - in the unlikely case
of mixing and matching different acknowledgement types.
items.translation: 此缓存大小是每个会话确认类型（auto、client、dups_ok、transacted）的缓存 Session 数量的最大限制。因此，实际缓存的 Session 数量可能高达指定值的四倍——在混合使用不同确认类型的罕见情况下。

items.source:
Default is 1: caching a single Session, (re-)creating further ones on
demand. Specify a number like 10 if you'd like to raise the number of cached
Sessions; that said, 1 may be sufficient for low-concurrency scenarios.
items.translation: 默认值为 1：缓存单个 Session，按需创建（重新）其他 Session。如果您希望增加缓存的 Session 数量，可以指定一个数字，例如 10；不过对于低并发场景，1 可能就足够了。

items.source:
Default is "true". Switch this to "false" in order to always
recreate MessageProducers on demand.
items.translation: 默认值为 "true"。将其切换为 "false" 以始终按需重新创建 MessageProducers。

items.source:
Default is "true". Switch this to "false" in order to always
recreate MessageConsumers on demand.
items.translation: 默认值为 "true"。将其切换为 "false" 以按需始终重新创建 MessageConsumers。

Wrap the given Session with a proxy that delegates every method call to it
but adapts close calls. This is useful for allowing application code to
handle a special framework Session just like an ordinary Session.
items.translation: 将给定的 Session 包装在一个代理中，该代理会将所有方法调用委托给它，但会适配 `close` 调用。这对于允许应用程序代码像处理普通 Session 一样处理特殊的框架 Session 非常有用。
